items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I played with Jack McVea when I was there

ctx.x: I could have stayed in California really, and made it. I made a lot of friends with there. Oh, I played with Jack McVea when I was there; I got to lead this band out there. I remember I played in San Diego with him at the...not the Cinderella, but one of those clubs out there.
